items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: I met his two sons, who were saxophone players and we became friends through the years, you know, they both played tenor, Rudy and I forget his brother's name.

ctx.x: No, it's the downstairs of the Empire State Building. So those were two stand-out jobs. But then I would have to go back to the club date thing again. So that was mainly the sixties, you know, you're doin' whatever you can do. So I decided I'd have to make a change. So I got a call. Fess Williams, who used to have a band at the Vendome in Chicago, and he played clarinet and he became an official at the union...then I met his two sons, who were saxophone players and we became friends through the years, you know,…
You went there first in what year?
